Answers could include. The data show that:

\begin{itemize}
\item The relationship is linear and positive/increasing. The correlation of $0.4564$ is weak/moderate.
\item As character age increases by 1 year, the actor age increases by almost 2 years.
\item The actors playing teenagers do not need to be teenagers themselves. The ages of characters range from 14 to 17 but the ages of actors playing these characters range from 14 to 30. This means that there is no need for just young actors but older people can play teenage characters.
\item There are only a few characters of age 14 and they are played by actors ranging in age between 14–23.
\item Characters of age 15 is the largest group and they are played by actors with the widest age range (14–27).
\item Characters older than 15 are all played by older actors. The youngest actors in the dataset are playing characters close to their own age.
\end{itemize}
